অর্থ মন্ত্রণালয়
অভ্যন্তরীণ সম্পদ বিভাগ
(কাস্টমস)

প্রজ্ঞাপন

তারিখ : ১৯ জ্যৈষ্ঠ, ১৪২৩ বঙ্গাব্দ/২ জুন, ২০১৬ খ্রিস্টাব্দ

Government of Bangladesh: The Ministry of Finance and the Internal Resources Division are authorized under this notification to exercise customs-related regulatory functions.
Internal Resources Division: This entity acts as the administrative authority within the Ministry of Finance responsible for issuing customs-related notifications and statutory orders.

এস.আর.ও. নং ১৬৭-আইন/২০১৬/২৯/কাস্টমস ।— Customs Act, 1969 (Act No. IV of 1969) এর section 18 এর sub-section (2) তে প্রদত্ত ক্ষমতাবলে সরকার, উক্ত Act এর FIRST SCHEDULE ভুক্ত নিম্নবর্ণিত TABLE এর কলাম (1) এ উল্লিখিত Heading এর বিপরীতে কলাম (2) এ উল্লিখিত H.S. Code এর বিপরীতে কলাম (3) এ বর্ণিত পণ্যের উপর কলাম (4) এ উল্লিখিত পরিমাণ Regulatory Duty (RD) আরোপ করিল, যথা :-

Customs Act 1969: This act serves as the foundational legal authority under which the Government exercises its power to levy Regulatory Duty on imports.
Section 18, sub-section (2) of this Act empowers the Government to impose Regulatory Duty on goods specified in the First Schedule.
First Schedule: The First Schedule of the Customs Act is utilized to categorize goods for the purpose of imposing Regulatory Duty based on their specific H.S. Code and description.
Regulatory Duty: The Government has imposed specific Regulatory Duty rates on various steel, iron, and copper products as listed in the associated table.
These duties are calculated based on the H.S. Code and product description, with rates varying depending on the specific commodity category.
H.S. Code: The goods subject to Regulatory Duty are identified by their corresponding H.S. Codes as outlined in the legal table.
Specific exclusions are provided for certain H.S. Codes within defined headings to clarify the scope of the duty application.
TABLE: The table provides a detailed classification of iron, steel, and copper products, mapping headings and H.S. Codes to their applicable Regulatory Duty rates.
